title: Feature Bundle Map
purpose: Data-only seed map that connects negotiated game profiles to reusable feature bundles, capabilities, artifact contracts, validators and runtime/export targets.
principles: A feature bundle is a planning unit, not an implementation shortcut.
Feature bundles group capabilities and contracts so new game ideas do not immediately become custom C# or Unity glue.
A game profile selects feature bundles; feature bundles select capabilities, artifact contracts, validators, prompt context packs and runtime/export requirements.
Bundles may be combined across genres: party RPG, city builder, visual novel, automation, survival, tactical and optional adult/NSFW overlays can coexist when explicitly selected.
Adult/NSFW support is represented as optional content overlay bundles and tagged artifact contracts, not as hidden behavior inside unrelated mechanics.
A feature bundle may require future Lua modules, C# validators or Unity adapters, but the bundle itself remains data-only.
When a required capability is missing, the system should create a library growth proposal instead of inventing untracked files.
Every bundle must declare validation focus so generated data can be checked automatically before human review.

selection_flow.title: Read approved or candidate game profile
Match optional feature bundles and overlays

bundle_categories.title: Core planning and validation
bundle_categories.purpose: Atlas, profile, validation, context and generator planning infrastructure.

bundle_categories.title: Gameplay foundation
bundle_categories.purpose: World, entities, items, stats, progression, quests, dialogue, combat and interaction.

bundle_categories.title: Runtime and export
bundle_categories.purpose: Runtime DB, Unity IR, asset index, save overlay and shell binding.

bundle_categories.title: Genre systems

bundle_categories.title: Content overlays

bundle_categories.title: Media generation

feature_bundles.title: Core Atlas Planning
feature_bundles.purpose: Provides the common planning spine: capability atlas, reference profiles, artifact contracts, validation levels and prompt context rules.
validation_focus: Do all selected bundles have known ids?
Are required artifact contracts registered?
Are required runtime targets known?
feature_bundles.notes: This bundle should be active for almost every project.

feature_bundles.title: Game Profile Negotiation
feature_bundles.purpose: Turns user discussion into compact profile variants that can drive capability selection and generator planning.
validation_focus: Does the profile declare required runtime targets?
Are optional overlays explicit instead of implied?
Are undecided choices represented as variants or unknowns?

feature_bundles.title: Semantic Property Channels
feature_bundles.purpose: Defines semantic channels for physical, material, equipment, combat, magic, social, memory, dialogue, economy, crafting, technical, location, faction, narrative, morphology and text surface data.
validation_focus: Do semantic facts use known channels?
Are generated facts traceable to profile/source knowledge?
Can text/runtime layers consume semantic traits without LLM at runtime?

feature_bundles.title: Text Templates and Morphology
feature_bundles.purpose: Supports reusable text templates, Russian morphology lexicon output, phrase variants and deterministic runtime text assembly.
validation_focus: Can generated text be assembled without runtime LLM?
Do morphology forms match known nouns/adjectives?
Do descriptions avoid physically impossible descriptors unless explicitly stylized?

feature_bundles.title: World Region and Chunk Generation
feature_bundles.purpose: Supports region, location, biome, chunk seed and map-area data for finite or expandable worlds.
validation_focus: Are chunks compact seeds/records instead of huge raw tile dumps?
Are locations traceable to regions/biomes?
Can runtime DB index locations efficiently?

feature_bundles.title: Might-and-Magic-like Party RPG
feature_bundles.purpose: Combines pseudo-3D/first-person exploration, party roster, paper-doll equipment, skills/spells, quests, factions and hybrid combat.
validation_focus: Can the profile run as a party RPG without runtime LLM state mutation?
Are party/inventory/combat/quest/faction refs consistent?
Can Unity adapter dry-run pseudo-3D bindings?

feature_bundles.title: Party Roster and Progression
feature_bundles.purpose: Defines party members, portraits, stats, classes, skills, progression and party-level state.
validation_focus: Are stats and progression bounded?
Are party members valid entity refs?
Can save.db separate current state from compiled character definitions?

feature_bundles.title: Inventory Paper-Doll Grid
feature_bundles.purpose: Supports grid inventory, item sizes, equipment slots, paper-doll overlay, containers and equip/unequip actions.
validation_focus: Are item shapes and slots compatible?
Can UI IR represent grid/paper-doll layout?
Are runtime actions deterministic?

feature_bundles.title: Realtime / Turn-Based Hybrid Combat
feature_bundles.purpose: Supports combat profiles that can switch or mix realtime and turn-based rules through deterministic combat state and bounded formulas.
validation_focus: Are formulas bounded and safe?
Can headless simulator smoke-test encounters?
Are statuses and abilities valid refs?

feature_bundles.title: Dialogue Choice Graph
feature_bundles.purpose: Supports deterministic dialogue nodes, choices, conditions, effects, routes and relationship/canon-safe state changes.
validation_focus: Are dialogue graphs reachable?
Do choices mutate state only through allowed effects?
Can routes be filtered by content overlays?

feature_bundles.title: Optional Free-Text Dialogue NLU
feature_bundles.purpose: Optional live text interpretation layer that converts player free text into proposed intents, never direct world-state mutations.
validation_focus: Does free text become a proposed intent instead of trusted fact?
Are state changes still deterministic runtime actions?
Can the system reject impossible player claims?

feature_bundles.title: Faction and Reputation
feature_bundles.purpose: Supports factions, relationships, reputation, diplomacy states, hostility, allegiance and reputation-gated content.
validation_focus: Are faction refs valid across quests/dialogue/combat?
Are reputation changes bounded?
Can diplomacy state live in save.db while faction definitions stay in runtime.db?

feature_bundles.title: Multi-Stage Quests
feature_bundles.purpose: Supports quest graphs, objectives, conditions, rewards, fail states, branching and replayable validation.
validation_focus: Can the quest be completed?
Are fail/branch states explicit?
Are rewards and required refs valid?

feature_bundles.title: Anno-1404-like City Builder with Conquest
feature_bundles.purpose: Combines settlement economy, population needs, production chains, trade, diplomacy, military pressure and region capture.
validation_focus: Are production chains solvable?
Can headless simulator test resource loops?
Are conquest/diplomacy refs valid?

feature_bundles.title: City Builder Production and Conquest
feature_bundles.purpose: Supports resources, production chains, population tiers, needs, trade routes, military pressure and region capture.
validation_focus: Can production graph be simulated?
Are population needs reachable?
Are trade and capture rules deterministic?

feature_bundles.title: Factorio-like Automation
feature_bundles.purpose: Supports factory resources, machines, recipes, networks, throughput, logistics and automation-focused validation.
validation_focus: Can resource flow be simulated headlessly?
Are recipe and machine refs valid?
Can UI/export represent networks compactly?

feature_bundles.title: The-Last-Sovereign-like Narrative Political RPG
feature_bundles.purpose: Combines political choices, relationship routes, economy/investment state, branching quests, mature themes and optional adult content overlays.
validation_focus: Are routes and relationship states reachable?
Are mature/adult overlays explicit and filterable?
Can political/economic state remain deterministic?

feature_bundles.title: Narrative Relationship Routes
feature_bundles.purpose: Supports relationship arcs, route gates, affection/trust/fear variables, scene availability and route-specific content overlays.
validation_focus: Are relationship variables bounded?
Can scenes be filtered by overlay/rating?
Are routes reachable and not contradictory?

feature_bundles.title: Optional Adult/NSFW Content Overlay
feature_bundles.purpose: Provides explicit tagged adult/NSFW overlay support for text, image requests, dialogue routes, scene metadata, audio cues and future animation requests when enabled by the project/profile.
validation_focus: Is the overlay explicitly enabled by profile?
Are all adult/NSFW artifacts tagged and filterable?
Can the project disable/export-filter the overlay without breaking core mechanics?
feature_bundles.notes: This bundle is optional and can apply across many genres. It is never implied by a model, reference profile or module.

feature_bundles.title: Optional Horror/Gore Content Overlay
feature_bundles.purpose: Provides explicit horror, gore, body-horror and dark-tone tags for projects that enable them.
validation_focus: Is horror/gore content explicitly enabled?
Are artifacts tagged and filterable?
Can export targets disable restricted content?

feature_bundles.title: Media Request Generation
feature_bundles.purpose: Generates structured requests for portraits, sprites, tilesets, item icons, locations, music, SFX, voice and future animation from approved game data.
validation_focus: Are media requests generated from approved game data?
Are content/rating tags explicit?
Can generated/imported assets be indexed before Unity export?

feature_bundles.title: Runtime DB Build Plan
feature_bundles.purpose: Defines how approved artifacts compile into read-only runtime.db, save schema, asset index, build manifest and related indexes.
validation_focus: Are immutable runtime data and mutable save data separated?
Are all compiled rows traceable to approved source artifacts?
Can the DB plan support headless smoke tests?

feature_bundles.title: Unity IR Runtime Shell
feature_bundles.purpose: Defines Unity-facing IR for scene, camera, input, UI, prefab, audio, VFX, interaction and runtime-shell binding descriptors.
validation_focus: Can the Unity shell consume the IR without generated per-game C#?
Are prefab/UI/audio/VFX bindings valid?
Can export dry-run catch missing assets?

feature_bundles.title: Survival Sandbox
feature_bundles.purpose: Supports survival needs, crafting, locations, resources, hazards, exploration and optional mature/horror overlays.
validation_focus: Can survival/crafting loops be simulated?
Are hazards and resources valid refs?
Are optional mature/horror overlays explicit?

validation_rules.summary: Every bundle must contain the required fields from bundle_shape.required_fields.
Every required bundle, capability, artifact contract, validator and runtime target must resolve to a known registry entry or produce a capability gap proposal.
Content overlay bundles must never be enabled implicitly by profile inspiration, model output or module defaults.
Selected bundles must have at least one compatible runtime target path or declare an unresolved runtime adapter gap.
New bundles, runtime-impacting bundle changes and overlay policy changes require human approval before activation.

future_module_gaps.summary: A stricter JSON Schema for feature_bundle_map.json can be added after the seed stabilizes.
Later C# can import feature bundles into Design DB after atlas seeds are stable.
Later planner can resolve profile -> feature bundles -> generator plan seed automatically.
Later validation can run bundle-specific smoke tests for economy, combat, dialogue and runtime DB planning.
